note: Research snapshot of pending Australian AML/CTF developments affecting legal practices. Every item is a watch item, not an obligation. Confirm each against its primary source at use time.

watch_items.item: Ministerial guidelines on legal professional privilege claims under section 242A
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: AUSTRAC's LPP guidance (last updated 1 July 2026) states the Minister for Home Affairs will issue guidelines covering review and challenge of LPP claims, further-information requests, handling of privileged information in searches and dispute resolution; not released at snapshot
watch_items.expected_trigger: Publication of the guidelines by the Minister or AUSTRAC

watch_items.item: Further AUSTRAC guidance and worked examples for professional designated services
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: AUSTRAC states its reform guidance pages are updated regularly; the professional designated-services guidance and legal profession program starter kit continue to be expanded with examples and sector detail
watch_items.expected_trigger: Updates to the professional designated-services guidance, the legal profession program starter kit or new sector-specific releases

watch_items.item: Amendments to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Rules 2025 and transitional rules
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: The AML/CTF Rules 2025 (F2025L01026) are in force as amended; AUSTRAC maintains transitional rules including staged obligations for some services; further amendment instruments are expected as the reform settles
watch_items.expected_trigger: Registration of amendment or transitional instruments on the Federal Register of Legislation

watch_items.item: First annual compliance report cycle for tranche 2 reporting entities
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: AUSTRAC's obligations summary describes an annual compliance report about how obligations were met the previous calendar year; the first cycle covering tranche 2 entities' 2026 obligations, and its lodgement window, had not been the subject of dedicated tranche 2 guidance located at snapshot
watch_items.expected_trigger: AUSTRAC guidance or AUSTRAC Online notice fixing the first tranche 2 compliance-report window
